name: cmdstan_reduce_sum_s1
busy_cpus_note: average number of busy logical CPUs during the run, inside and outside the taskset list; work outside it is other work on the machine (CPUs 12-23 are the SMT siblings of 0-11, so it competes for the same cores)

extra.gradients_note: sampling iterations only: sum of n_leapfrog__ plus one per transition; warmup not recorded
extra.sampling_note: the cmdstanpy sample() call: CmdStan processes including writing CSV
extra.settings: models/dynpois_reduce_sum.stan, STAN_THREADS, threads_per_chain=3, grainsize 1; stanc --O1, CXXFLAGS=-march=native (CmdStan's -O3); default NUTS (diag_e, adapt_delta 0.8, max_treedepth 10); 4 chains, parallel_chains=4, 1000 warmup + 1000 draws

recovered.why: post-processing crashed on CSV column names (beta[1] instead of CmdStan's beta.1) after sampling finished; the CSV files were post-processed afterwards by recover_cmdstan.py
